## Code Review

This pull request restructures the trace file storage system to use a more granular directory hierarchy based on author and operation type (e.g., `traces/{author}/{op_type}/{definition}.jsonl`). It also renames the default baseline author from 'flashinfer' to 'baseline' across the codebase and updates the web data loader and various scripts to support the new path structure. Feedback was provided regarding a missing directory creation step in the `add_traces` method which could cause failures when writing to new paths. Additionally, it was recommended to revert the top-level import of `matplotlib.pyplot` to maintain lazy loading and avoid making it a mandatory dependency for non-plotting tasks.
